verdict.rationale: Meltano advertises 600+ built-in connectors spanning SaaS APIs, databases, and files, and community evidence confirms real-world use extracting from multiple SaaS sources (Zoom, Slack, Gmail) at GitLab. Docs also show a CLI-driven workflow (`meltano add tap-github`) for adding connectors and an SDK for building custom ones when needed. Missing for 10: independent verification of connector maintenance quality/freshness across the catalog, and no comparative data on connector reliability versus rivals.
